subject: Connecting on Danon disease community efforts
body:
Dear Danon Foundation team,

My name is Maria, and I lead a patient group supporting families affected by Danon disease. I'm reaching out because your organisation describes itself as "a community of people living with or affected by Danon disease" [Ebb89110], and you've noted that your partnerships "support our mission to serve the Danon community" with a commitment to "supporting people all over the world that live with Danon disease" [E5453000]. Given our shared focus on this same community, I believe there could be valuable opportunities for us to learn from each other's work and potentially coordinate on outreach or resources for families.

Would you be open to a brief call in the coming weeks to introduce our groups and explore whether there are natural ways to collaborate or support one another's efforts?

Thank you for the work you do for the Danon community. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Maria
Patient Group Leader

Sources:
[Ebb89110] https://www.danonfoundation.org/about-us/
[E5453000] https://www.danonfoundation.org/about-us/partners/
